newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germans jailed for porn films made in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Germans jailed for porn films made in Thailand.

text.p: A Berlin court broke new legal ground on Wednesday when it sentenced two German men to jail for producing pornographic films with young boys in Thailand and selling them in Germany.
In the first such verdict in Germany, the court handed down sentences of four years and four years and 10 months for what it called "a very dirty and extremely shabby business."

It also found the defendants guilty of sexual abuse but said they were not the "sex monsters" depicted in the German media. They were also "different in character" than those responsible for recent cases of child abuse and murder in Belgium.
The two men, aged 33 and 43, who confessed to filming and photographing sex scenes with boys as young as nine years old in Pattaya, a beach resort south of Bangkok famous for its red light district.
The court called the men "typical sex tourists", who found boys in bars and sex movie theatres and paid them 50 marks ($35) for each photo session or film they appeared in.

They had launched their own company in Germany two years ago to distribute the pornographic material with a mailing list of 1,200 addresses, but customs officials intercepted packages with obscene photographs and order forms and tipped off police.
The men had a mailing list of 1200 addresses and earned almost 23,000 marks ($15,000) between 1994 and 1995 from the sale of photos and videos.

In September, a Frankfurt court sentenced a German man to two years in prison for having sex on camera with a 10-year-old girl during a holiday in Thailand. Customs officials confiscated the video when he returned to Germany.
These cases were among the first in which German authorities have managed to track down suspects under a 1993 law letting them pursue Germans who commit sex offences abroad.
An estimated 200,000 German men travel abroad each year in search of sex, many seeking girls under 14, according to German child welfare experts.
